title: MAIN STORYLINE: ALL QUIET UNDER THE THUNDER OPEN
lines: 01 MAIN THEME EPISODE 12: All Quiet under the Thunder OPEN
OPENS AT: October 24, 2023, 10:00 (UTC-7)
UNLOCK REQUIREMENT: Clear 11-21 in the Main Theme Episode 11: Return to Mist
[Cleaner's Collection]
OPENS AT: October 24, 2023, 10:00 (UTC-7)
DETAILS: By clearing stages of Main Theme: All Quiet under the Thunder in different environments, you can unlock the content of Cleaner’s Collection and obtain the corresponding rewards.
Reward : Main Theme Bonus Operator [★★★★★: Morgan], Morgan's Tokens, Logistics Special Permits, Icon - 'Shackles of Shadow', Plaque - Horizons, Plaque - Within Reach, Elite Materials, LMD, etc.
NOTE:

- Logistics Special Permit: In any 3-starred stage in 'All Quiet Under the Thunder' with Auto Deploy available, the 'Logistics Special Permit' can be used in the first 2 battles daily. When used, operations consume no Sanity and the normal Regular Drops are changed to Guaranteed Drops with 3x quantity.
- Logistics Special Permits are only obtainable from October 24, 2023, 10:00 AM to November 7, 2023, 03:59 AM via 'Cleaner's Collection'. They will expire after: November 7, 2023, 03:59 AM.
- Certain milestones require Emergency Dispatch missions to be completed in order to claim rewards.
02 ALL QUIET UNDER THE THUNDER ENCOURAGE EVENT OPEN
DURATION: October 24, 2023, 10:00 - November 7, 2023, 03:59 (UTC-7)
DETAILS: During the event, fail to challenge uncleared stages in All Quiet under the Thunder will refund all Sanity consumed.
03 ALL QUIET UNDER THE THUNDER LIMITED-TIME DROP EVENT OPEN
DURATION: October 24, 2023, 10:00 - November 7, 2023, 03:59 (UTC-7)
DETAILS: During the event, all stages that consume Sanity (except Annihilation, Intermezzi, and Side Story stages) will have a chance to drop the following items.
- Emergency Sanity Sampler (Use to restore 10 Sanity)
- Rhodes Island Supplies (Use to get randomly specified Materials)
NOTE:
Emergency Sanity Samplers from this event will expire on November 27, 2023, 03:59 (UTC-7)
04 LIMITED-TIME HEADHUNTING OPEN – AS IN MY ADUMBRATION
DURATION: October 24, 2023, 10:00 - November 7, 2023, 03:59 (UTC-7)
DETAILS: During the event, the Limited-time Headhunting, [As In My Adumbration], opens and the following Operators will appear at a higher rate from this Standard Headhunting:
★★★★★: Cement / Windflit
★★★★: Humus
05 NEW OPERATORS AVAILABLE
DETAILS: The following Operators will be added to the game.
★★★★★: Cement
★★★★★: Morgan
★★★★: Humus
NOTE:
- New Operator Morgan can only be obtained from Cleaner’s Collection in Episode 12: All Quiet under the Thunder, and is NOT available in any Standard Headhunting or Kernel Headhunting.
- After the As In My Adumbration banner ends, Ines, Cement, and Humus will become available in other Standard Headhuntings after November 7, 2023, 04:00 AM (UTC-7).

- During October 24, 2023, 10:00 - November 7, 2023, 03:59 (UTC-7), Operator Ines, Cement, Morgan, and Humus will gain more Trust from all stages that consume Sanity (except Annihilation, Intermezzi, and Side Story stages).
06 Limited-Time Tactical Support Event - Phrase II
DURATION: October 24, 2023, 12:00 (UTC-7) - November 7, 2023, 03:59 (UTC-7)

DETAILS: During the event, players can complete missions in [Limited-Time Tactical Support Event] by clearing stages in 'Main Theme' to obtain rewards, including Emergency Sanity Booster, Emergency Sanity Concentrate, etc. Furthermore, all Operators will earn more Trust in Main Theme stages and Supplies stages after certain requirement being met; certain Operators can receive additional Trust boost. The two effects can stack.
NOTE ：
- The Emergency Sanity Booster and the Emergency Sanity Concentrate gained from this event will expire on November 20, 2023, 03:59 (UTC-7).
- Players who have already met the requirements before the event can directly claim the rewards when the event opens.

- During the event, players can unlock Trust boost for Operators after clearing 10-1 under any Environment; players who have already cleared 10-1 before the event can directly gain the effect. After new Episode opens, players can unlock the additional Trust boost after clearing 12-1 under any Environment.
- After Phrase II opens, the following Operators will gain more trust during the event: Ines, Cement, Humus.
- The mentioned Trust-up effect stacks with the "New Operators Trust-up" bonus.
07 EPOQUE COLLECTION NEW ARRIVALS AT THE OUTFIT STORE
DURATION: October 24, 2023, 10:00 - November 7, 2023, 03:59 (UTC-7)
DETAILS: The following Outfits will be available at the Outfit Store, including:
- Epoque Collection - To Effloresce Whitely for Horn
- Epoque Collection - A Thousand Correspondences for Heidi
- Epoque Collection - Invitation for Harmonie
08 [Raythean Striker] & [Bloodline of Combat Collection] Re-edition at the Outfit Store
DURATION: October 24, 2023, 10:00 - November 7, 2023, 03:59 (UTC-7)
DETAILS: The following Re-edition Outfits will be available at the Outfit Store, including:
- Raythean Striker Series - City Destroyer for Siege
- Raythean Striker Series - Valiant General for Indra
- Raythean Striker Series - Survive for Scavenger
- Bloodline of Combat Collection - Octopath Illusion for Hellagur
- Bloodline of Combat Collection - Wind of Breaking Blade for Shirayuki
09 VITAFIELD [Foruiner] Series Classics RE-EDITION
DURATION: October 31, 2023, 16:00 – November 14, 2023, 03:59 (UTC-7)
DETAILS: The following Outfit will be available at the Store:
- Vitafield [Foruiner] Series Classics - Tranquil Moss for Heavyrain
10 NEW FURNITURE SET Glasgow Gang Boxing Gym
DURATION: October 24, 2023, 10:00 – November 7, 2023, 03:59 (UTC-7)
DETAILS: A brand new set of themed Furniture, Glasgow Gang Boxing Gym, will be available at the Store.
11 NEW LUCKY DROP FURNITURE SET Catastrophe Observatory
UPDATE TIME: October 24, 2023, 10:00 (UTC-7)
LUCKY DROP: Themed Furniture - Catastrophe Observatory
HOW TO OBTAIN: By clearing Main Theme stages (excludes Challenge Mode and tutorial stages) and all Supplies stages.

DETAILS: New furniture series, Catastrophe Observatory, will replace the current furniture series in the Lucky Drop, Sugar Pome Fairy's Banquet Hall. After the replacement, Sugar Pome Fairy's Banquet Hall series furniture can be purchased at the store.
Sugar Pome Fairy's Banquet Hall will be available at the Store after October 24, 2023, 10:00 (UTC-7).
12 CHIP PACK AVAILABLE FOR A LIMTIED TIME
DURATION: October 24, 2023, 10:00 – November 7, 2023, 03:59 (UTC-7)
DETAILS: During the events, the following pack will be available from the Store for a limited time.
CONCEAL CHIP PACK
CONTENTS: Vanguard Dualchip * 4, Vanguard Chip * 5, Skill Summary - 3 * 45, Skill Summary - 2 * 25, Skill Summary - 1 * 10
OTHERS:
'A Walk in the Dust' Permanently Available in [Side Story]
Available after: October 31, 2023, 16:00 (UTC-7)
'Critical Response Team Office' Furniture Set Permanently Available in the Store
Available after: October 31, 2023, 16:00 (UTC-7)
